test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What was the theme of The Financial Literacy Week 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Farmers.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The theme of **The Financial Literacy Week 2019** was focused on **Farmers**, aimed at enhancing financial literacy among the farming community.
 
• The initiative emphasized the importance of financial inclusion, enabling farmers to access banking services, credit, and insurance effectively.
 
• It aimed to educate farmers about the various financial products available to them, including loans, savings accounts, and investment options.
 
• The campaign also highlighted the significance of budgeting, saving, and planning for agricultural seasons and emergencies.
 
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) organized this week as part of its ongoing efforts to promote financial literacy and empower individuals in rural areas.
 
• Dates of Observation: The week was observed from June 3 to June 7. The theme of the Financial Literacy Week 2019 was Farmers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Financial Literacy Week (FLW)**: An initiative by the Reserve Bank of India, FLW is observed annually to promote financial awareness and education among different segments of society.
 
• **Objectives of FLW**: The primary objectives include increasing awareness about banking products, encouraging savings, and promoting prudent financial management practices.
 
• **Outreach Programs**: During the week, various workshops, seminars, and outreach programs are conducted to engage farmers and other target audiences effectively.
 
• **Importance for Farmers**: Financial literacy is crucial for farmers to manage their finances, make informed decisions regarding loans and investments, and cope with market fluctuations.
 
• **Previous Themes**: Previous editions of Financial Literacy Week have focused on different themes, addressing the financial needs of various segments like women, youth, and small businesses.
